reason: The document says lines are independent expressions but also says all lines belong to one logical decision.
impact: Could produce a false positive if the implementation reports separate decisions while the intended grouping is different.
disposition: Kept as one of two contradictory executable expectations; not resolved.

description: Interprets all valid .mcdc lines as one reported decision
reason: This preserves the incompatible same-decision statement without choosing a precedence.
impact: Could produce a false positive if the implementation reports separate decisions.
disposition: Kept as the opposing executable expectation; not resolved.

description: Selects mandatory temporal over optional temporal for an absent field

reason: C3 separately says direct mode does not construct a complete table.
